outputs.explanation: Stacked bar/area chart shows median promoter-state frequencies per Pol II-enrichment bin, aggregating thousands of promoters per bin, but no individual promoter data points are overlaid.

Each row of the single-molecule stack already represents an individual DNA molecule (raw data), so individual data points are inherently displayed; the sidebar frequency summary is accompanied by the raw molecule-level plot.

Single-molecule stack for the mouse Skp1 locus displays each individual molecule as a row, so the underlying individual data are directly shown alongside the summary sidebar.
